items.name: sure
items.title: Sure
items.description: Awaitable confirmation dialogs. Mount <Sure /> once, then await sure.confirm(), sure.alert(), sure.prompt(), sure.type() (type a phrase to confirm) or sure.undo() (undo toast) from any event handler. Resolves true or false, or the entered value for prompt.
items.docs: Add <Sure /> and the shadcn <Toaster /> to your root layout.

items.name: click-again-button
items.title: Click Again Button
items.description: A Button that asks for a second click before it confirms. The first click swaps the label to "Click again to confirm" and a second click within the timeout calls onConfirm. Blur or timeout cancels. Includes the useClickAgain hook.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: A Button that confirms after being pressed and held. A fill sweeps across the button while it is held and drains if released early. Works with mouse, touch, Space and Enter.
